verdict.rationale: LangSmith exposes traces via a documented API (filter/export via API) and has an official MCP server repo (langsmith-mcp-server) confirming agent-queryable access, but the evidence pack lacks detail on whether the MCP server or API surfaces metrics and eval results specifically, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP coverage of metrics dashboards and eval-result querying, and independent confirmation the MCP server works well in practice.
